articles.title: Silver futures rise to ₹2.08 lakh per kg
articles.excerpt:
Silver prices rose 0.27 per cent to ₹2.08 lakh per kg in futures trade on Thursday amid a firm global trend.

On the Multi Commodity Exchange, the white metal for December delivery rose by ₹561 or 0.27 per cent, to ₹2,08,899 per kilogram in a business turnover of 3,125 lots.

Fresh positions built by participants led to a rise in silver prices, analysts said.

In the overseas market, silver futures rose 0.61 per cent to $55.89 per ounce.

articles.excerpt:
In a notable financial scenario, the Indian rupee appreciated by 0.1% against the dollar, securing its fourth consecutive day of gains. This uptick was attributed to decreasing oil prices alongside a boost in Indian stock performance, which went against the regional market tide. Concurrently, a decline in the dollar index from an 18-month peak, influenced by lower Treasury yields and Federal Reserve rate hike speculations, supported this trend.

articles.title: Bitcoin Slides as Wall Street Risk Pullback Tests Bullish Turn
articles.excerpt:

The largest digital asset traded around $81,500. Crypto markets weakened as hotter inflation data and a renewed selloff in chipmakers hit appetite for speculative trades across markets. The Nasdaq 100 dropped as much as 2%, the dollar rose to its highest level since May 2025 and traders lifted bets on further Federal Reserve rate hikes after September consumer prices rose at the fastest pace since April.
